facts.text: LSUA was approved to establish Louisiana's first 90-credit-hour accelerated bachelor's degrees in high-demand STEM fields including Information Technology and Bioinformatics.

sources.title: LSU Board of Supervisors Approves LSUA to Advance Louisiana's First Three-Year Accelerated Bachelor's STEM Degrees
sources.quote: The LSU Board of Supervisors has unanimously approved Louisiana State University of Alexandria (LSUA) to move forward with the development and implementation of two innovative 90-credit-hour accelerated bachelor's degrees in high-demand STEM fields.
